info.name: Arduino IoT Cloud binaries_v2 usage_internal API

items.docs: Upserts a batch of per-(owner, thing, device, date) message counters. The payload carries two flat lists, users_usage and orgs_usage, that can be populated independently in the same request. Rows in users_usage must be unique by (user_id, thing_id, device_id, date). Rows in orgs_usage must be unique by (org_id, thing_id, device_id, date). Duplicate rows are rejected with 400 Bad Request.
